t: DEWALT Heavy Duty 14mm staple and brad tacker with lightweight, die-cast aluminium housing provides durability, whilst reducing user fatigue during prolonged tasks. The robust manual fastening tool features an anti-jam mechanism to ensure consistent, reliable performance, and a rear-loading, open-view magazine which allows swift fastener checks and reloading. Easy squeeze technology and a plastic comfort grip help reduce actuation force. Ideal for professional trade use and serious DIYers during insulation, carpet fitting, or light upholstery work. The versatile tacker accommodates 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14mm staples and 12 and 15mm brads.
